title: Switching from clarinet to drums; godfather as teacher
summary: He tried clarinet, took up drums on kitchen utensils and chairs, and his godfather taught him.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the horn: first instrument and the trombone

blocks.x: That's alright. Tell us about when you started to take up music. What did you start on?
Well, I always did admire the Clarnie players. Clarnie was always... I'd sit under them all the time.
And I started taking up clarinet.

But I couldn't execute it. I knew it. I knew the favor and everything, but I couldn't execute fast enough. So I just got disgusted and... I switched over to drums. Who was your teacher? Well, who was my teacher? That time... I didn't have no teacher. At that time when I started because... I started with some knives and forks in the kitchen. That's how I started. You mean on the drums? Yeah, I used to... I used to... I used to... I used to play on the chairs.
I used to play on the chairs. I mean on the higher net, who was your teacher?
Oh, who was my teacher? Well, my... My godfather was my teacher. He... His name was Paul Shalini. Paul Shalini. He died a few years back. He was my teacher.
